name: What should I prepare before starting an interior build-out project?
description: Prepare your business needs, budget, timeline, design preferences, and any lease requirements before starting a project.

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before starting an interior build-out project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting an interior build-out project, it's beneficial to have a clear understanding of your business needs, budget, and desired timeline. Gathering inspiration for your design preferences and having a list of essential features for your space will also be helpful. If you have a lease agreement, familiarize yourself with any tenant improvement allowances or landlord requirements. This preparation helps streamline the initial consultation and design phases.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare your business needs, budget, timeline, design preferences, and any lease requirements before starting a project.
